players.product: on-premises superconducting quantum computers (five-qubit IQM Spark; IQM Radiance, approximately 20 to 150 qubits) and IQM Resonance cloud

quarterly_data.quarter: IQM Quantum Computers press release: TOYO Corporation opens its quantum computers to Japan's (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TOYO Corporation purchased a second IQM full-stack quantum computer, an IQM Spark for its R&D center in Kiba, Tokyo, after its earlier purchase of an IQM Radiance 20-qubit system planned for installation at the end of 2026 at AIST's G-QuAT research center; IQM will deliver both systems by the end of 2026 and both will be operational in early 2027, with TOYO opening access to Japan's wider quantum ecosystem. IQM's Asia-Pacific installed base already includes systems delivered in South Korea and Taiwan.
quarterly_data.figure: second system (IQM Spark) after a Radiance 20-qubit system; both delivered by the end of 2026
